item.title: How to Give Your 1st Conference Talk!
item.description:
The Goldmine Nobody Told You About

Here is something nobody tells you on day one of a new job: every role, at every company, if you do it right, quietly turns into a research project.

You get handed a ticket. The ticket asks a small, boring question. And if you actually chase the answer instead of just closing the ticket, that question drags you sideways into a rabbit hole you did not know existed. Suddenly you are three tabs deep into a spec, then a mailing list thread from 2019, then someone’s changelog, then you are debugging something that was never really your job, purely because you have to know.
